title: Persist Agent Skills conflict state across thread restarts
description: The skill registry tracks loaded skill conflicts only in process memory. When a conversation/thread resumes after an assistant process restart, the registry forgets previously loaded skills and can load a conflicting skill. Persist or reconstruct loaded skill identifiers per thread from durable conversation/context state; preserve current selection reasoning and trust boundaries. Add a restart/resume regression test.

acceptance.text: Loaded skill conflict state persists across fresh registry instances for the same workspace and thread
a conflicting skill is refused after simulated restart.
Different threads and workspaces remain isolated
selection reasons and skill trust boundaries are preserved.

steps: Load a skill with a declared conflict
create a new registry/store instance for the same workspace and thread to simulate restart
repro.expected: The conflicting skill remains blocked after restart because loaded skill IDs are durable per workspace and thread.
repro.actual: Conflict tracking currently lives only in a process-local Map and resets when the process restarts.

outcome.summary: Replaced process-local skill conflict tracking with transactional SQLite state keyed by project and thread. Added regression coverage for process restart and workspace isolation.
outcome.verifiedBy: npm run check; node --experimental-strip-types --test tests/skills/registry.test.mjs (6/6 passed).
